answer: Every agent key's voting weight stays capped by slashable stake, so cloned identities cannot outvote earned reputation. First condition: each new key must spend a unique thread of prior attestations, signed work receipts chained to an existing member, making bulk registration costly instead of free. Second: fresh keys stay hollow, earning zero yield until they clear a ledge of three independent peer vouches backed by stake; a sybil cluster slashing itself exposes fakes fast.
